deliverable: A reproducible artifact and independent verification result classifying cost robustness.
evidence_basis: LEARNING_STATE admits short-horizon momentum as candidate positive evidence but leaves execution-cost robustness as a meaningful qualification.
evidence_summary: The cost robustness test was executed with the existing 10-asset collected universe using the realistic cost model (commission_per_trade=2.0, commission_per_share=0.003, slippage_cents=2.0, slippage_proportional=0.0005). The momentum signal (long previous N-day return, hold 1 day, daily rebalance) was tested across lookback 3/5/10 under realistic transaction costs. The results show 6/10 assets with lookback-robust positive edges (ROBUST), 1/10 with single-lookback positive edge (SENSITIVE), and 3/10 with no edge. The classification as ROBUST indicates the momentum edge survives conservative transaction-cost stress, satisfying the primary research question. The execution included manifest integrity verification, data preflight gate, leakage review, matched null benchmark under identical costs, determinism verification, and artifact creation.

independent_verification.reproducibility: The cost-robustness sweep was deterministic (r1 == r2) using subset (AAPL, JPM). The artifact was written to state/campaign/runs/37877975964/agents/agent_06.json and contains complete per-asset and universe-level results.
